verdict.rationale: In the IDE, every Cline edit appears as a diff you can review, modify or revert, with checkpoints and linter-aware fixes. Kanban adds per-card diff review with inline comments. It runs tests and reacts to their output live, can review `git diff` output, and can run headlessly in GitHub Actions or GitLab pipelines as a pre-merge step. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on a pre-merge gating or PR-check workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of running checks (community evidence only praises diff quality).
